_provenance.method: current boundaries only (valid_end empty); properties trimmed to ava_id, name, aka, state, county, within, contains, cfr_index, valid_start; Douglas-Peucker 0.0001° per ring (under the 12.2 m accuracy of the USGS 1:24,000 base); coordinates rounded to 5 decimals. A generalized digitization of 27 CFR Part 9, not TTB's legal boundary.
